create_modelopt_fp8_config: create ModelOptFp8Config from quantization config dict for static FP8 weight and activation quantization
create_modelopt_fp4_config: create ModelOptFp4Config from quantization config dict for NVFP4 block-scaled quantization on Blackwell GPUs
create_modelopt_mixed_config: create ModelOptMixedPrecisionConfig routing layers to FP8 or NVFP4 based on quantized_layers map
apply_modelopt_fp8_linear: apply ModelOptFp8LinearMethod to run FP8 quantized linear forward pass with per-tensor scales
apply_modelopt_fp4_linear: apply ModelOptFp4LinearMethod to run NVFP4 quantized linear forward pass with block scales and per-tensor scales
